DiffieHellman is the Java SE spelling of DH, and EC is absent from the derived rule -- a rule defect (tier map D2) adopted rather than repaired.

The derived rule admits MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-224 because API 30 publishes them. This widens the allow-list: the profile models availability, not recommendation.
